Initial release.

- Validation and expected outputs ensure responses are actionable, tailored, and reusable.

- Initial release of "work-productivity-proactive-agent-workflow-helper" skill for Clawhub.
- Helps users implement, troubleshoot, and enhance Proactive Agent-style workflows, with strong validated demand.
